message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features two caricatured men with oversized heads wearing black songkok hats. The man on the left, shown from the chest up, has a wide face, squinting eyes, and a broad smile. He wears a dark pinstriped suit, white shirt, and red tie, holding a small black rectangular object resembling a phone in his right hand. The man on the right is taller, with an elongated face, large ears, and an open-mouthed grin. He wears a white button-down shirt. His right hand points upward with two fingers extended.

The background is a dark, smoky grey. Small, yellowish paper sketches of five different male faces are taped around the main figures. Some sketches include name-like text such as "yani afri," "NOVEL," and "dedi hamdun." Large teal letters at the top spell "TEMPO." White text reads "PETAI HAMPA DEBAT PRESIDEN," "DARI KUTA PARADISO KE NEGERI SINGA," and "PACEKLIK OBAT PENGIDAP HIV." A white box at the bottom left contains a barcode and publication details: "21-27 JANUARI 2019," "RP 45.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273."
